summary: Complete frontend testing of CubiQo 3D plasma particle wave effect. All requested features working perfectly including HD rendering, color gradients, AI state changes, mouse interaction, and smooth animations.
passed_tests: Landing page loads without errors - no JavaScript errors detected
HD plasma wave ribbons render at 1920x1080 with 120,000+ particles across 4 layers
Color gradients work perfectly - cyan/blue left → purple center → pink/red right
All 5 AI state buttons (neutral, thinking, speaking, listening, error) functional
AI state indicator updates correctly when buttons clicked
Audio toggle button clickable and responsive (microphone permission expected denied in test env)
Mouse interaction affects wave motion - tested across multiple positions
Multiple wave layers create visible depth effect with proper Z-positioning
Hero content displays correctly - CubiQo title and tagline centered
Smooth wave animation confirmed across 5 test frames
Responsive design works on desktop (1920x1080), tablet (768x1024), mobile (390x844)
3D Canvas renders properly with WebGL support
Wave ribbons show proper glow shaders and HD visual effects
